verdict.rationale: Radar lets developers use custom metadata, value lists, and business-specific attributes in rules (stripe-radar-docs-3, stripe-radar-docs-10, stripe-radar-docs-14), and Radar Sessions can capture additional fraud signals (stripe-radar-docs-15), but these largely feed a separate rules/allow-list layer rather than directly retraining or reweighting the underlying ML risk score with developer-supplied device fingerprints or behavioral data. Missing for 10: documented mechanism for custom signals to alter the core Radar score itself (not just trigger rules), first-party support for arbitrary device-fingerprint ingestion, and independent confirmation that custom metadata materially changes scoring outcomes.
